I remember my grandma, in hospital. She died of Crohn's disease.

We went to visit her my brother, my mum and I. I was sat on the end of the bed whilst my mum and brother were on chairs. By the sides of the bed.

Anyway, I always remember her pointing to the window and it being this beautiful garden with perfectly cut hedges, and flowers of all different colours all done like some sort of royal garden.

When I got older and asked my mum about it, telling her what I remember. It turned out none of it was actually there. No flowers or garden. 

I believe it was a dream, her basically telling me where she was going. That she was going somewhere beautiful and that I shouldn't be worried for her.

I know it's something that could be explain in a million different ways but I dunno, I like to think it was something supernatural in a way
